titles.title: DRIVE Across America Act of 2026
Deploying Revolutionary and Innovative Vehicle Energy-supply Across America Act of 2026
DRIVE Across America Act of 2026

A bill to establish the Cleaner Transportation at Recreational Areas to Improve our Landmarks and Sites (Cleaner TRAILS) Initiative to facilitate the installation of zero-emission vehicle fueling infrastructure on National Forest System land, National Park System land, and certain related land, and for other purposes.

action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources.
